mapper.select: SELECT id AS recordId, event_id AS eventId, status_before AS statusBefore, status_after AS statusAfter, process_result AS processResult, process_opinion AS processOpinion, processed_by AS processedBy, to_char(processed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS processedAt, source AS source FROM ai_event_process_record WHERE event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY processed_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_event_process_record (id, event_id, event_no, status_before, status_after, process_result, process_opinion, processed_by, processed_at, source, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventId}, #{eventNo}, #{statusBefore}, #{statusAfter}, #{processResult}, #{processOpinion}, #{processedBy}, #{processedAt}, #{source}, #{createdAt})
